findings: Strict schema, complete ordered questions, opaque known document IDs and bounded integer line ranges are checked before output creation.
Line semantics preserve the original validator convention and content whitespace.
Raw inputs and full questions/corpus/compiler/output identities are retained; output reuse is refused.
Tests exercise the current compiler/CLI and demonstrate that a false claim can pass mechanical citation checks.
operational_limit: Ordinary writes are not crash durability; a future cleanup workflow must independently preserve outputs before deleting originals. The compiler deletes nothing.
